name: Verify chat panel meets color contrast requirements
objective: Validate text contrast ratio meets WCAG AA (4.5:1)

steps.description: Check message text color contrast ratio against background
steps.expectedResult: Message text meets WCAG AA contrast ratio of 4.5:1 or higher

steps.description: Check input field text color contrast ratio
steps.expectedResult: Input text meets WCAG AA contrast ratio of 4.5:1 or higher

steps.description: Check button text/icon color contrast ratio
steps.expectedResult: Button elements meet WCAG AA contrast ratio of 4.5:1 or higher
